parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural similarity is purely that they are zero-field type aliases — not that they alias the same underlying type or serve the same domain concept. `ApplicationWillTerminateMessage` (Core package, application lifecycle), `PlaybackStalledMessage` and `HLSPlaybackStalledMessage` (Playback package, two distinct player subsystems), and `RequestSentMessage` (MusicShareKit package, network request signalling) each encode unrelated domain events whose coincidence is entirely structural. Collapsing them into a shared type would conflate unrelated message semantics and couple three independent packages (`Core`, `Playback`, `MusicShareKit`) without any real abstraction gain. No restraint markers are present, but the domain-concept divergence is sufficient to prefer no-action.
